    // Who we are

    A room, a rubric,and people who answer

    We started in 2022 with one live room and twelve people. The format has not changed — only the number of rooms, and the fact that instructors now earn a living from them.

    Three patterns, one mark

    The mark is a single unbroken line folded into a W. Continue its lines and the loop completes into a fingerprint: the arch and the loop are two of its three basic patterns. The ring is the world in our tagline.

    We teach the way that line works. Learn, build, ship, repeat — and keep the loop going until the job is done.
